name: A Traitor's Confession
description: A sealed letter, the wax broken by someone other than its intended reader.
paragraphs: By the time you read this I will already be gone, and you will already know what I did. I want you to know it was not for gold, whatever they tell you.
They had my daughter. Three months, they had her, and I said nothing because I did not know if saying something would save her or kill her faster.
I opened the east gate. I would do it again. I hope you never have to find out whether you would too.
